question: Where are nectar drops from the auspicious cup to be applied around the bindu?
premises: The central location is the middle of the bindu
The surrounding locations are the four directions
The means are drops of nectar from the auspicious cup
inference: Drops of nectar from the auspicious cup are applied in the center of the bindu and in the four directions.
uncertainties: The deities receiving these drops are named in the following verses
plain_english: In the center of the bindu and in the four directions, one uses drops of nectar from the auspicious cup.
